採用・広告の製品.quote: We handle the integration. You upload the jobs to your robot — and it welds. No teach pendant, no programming, no roboticist.
The robot plans the path, adapts to the part in front of it, and welds like an expert, every shift. No teach pendant, no programming.

Tekton Dynamics exists to put these tools into every manufacturer's hands, so the power to invent and build at scale is not a privilege of the few.

To advance industry and secure supply chains, every economy must answer the work that no longer attracts a human workforce. We build AI for the dull, dirty, and dangerous — offloading the hazardous and the mundane to intelligent machines, so manufacturers can compete globally while creating new, purposeful jobs locally. The future of making remains human-centric, accessible, and boundless.
20+ years · AI · robotics · production engineering
PhD and PostDoc in Machine Learning, Oxford University. Previously the Alan Turing Institute and McKinsey & Co.
Former co-founder & CTO of an AI startup, with a decade of software engineering experience at LinkedIn, Etsy, and Frame.io shipping production interfaces.
Robotics Researcher, Cambridge University. Previously robotics engineer and hardware lead at a UK robotics company.
We tackle the hardest problems in industrial AI and robotics.
We hire for trajectory, not checklists.
Every engineer spends time on the shop floor — at our own industrial lab and at our customers. The hardest problems in industrial AI are the ones you only see standing right by the cell.
We optimize for one thing: how fast a problem gets solved. Only results matter.
We dive into first principles, question every assumption, and embrace heterodox thinking on the hardest technical problems.
Continuous improvement is non-negotiable. Direct feedback with candor and kindness — low egos, high trust, high growth.
